name: minigun
notes: Six barrels on a gearbox: it takes half a second to come up to speed, then holds a wall of bullets on a target. Weak per round and it wanders, so it is a weapon for holding a corridor, not for duels across the hall. Belt-fed from the drum, so it never reloads: the spin-up is the wait it has instead. The right button fires all six barrels at once: a ring of burning flechettes, six rounds off the drum, at the scrap gun's pace. Each one hits harder than a bullet and bites a voxel out of whatever it strikes; the ring holds together inside ten metres and opens round a target past it.
